title: Use approximate row geometry without inventing a coherent hidden process
statement: The compact probability-simplex/rank-minor optimization attains w_r(P). At a cut, actual-P prefix samples index the hidden normalized nonnegative rows; E||R_h-s_h||_1^2<=4D(P||R)+4e_t pays all sampled-row errors. Projection and telescoping always use actual P and teacher joint restrictions, never shadow children, so inconsistent cutwise families are legitimate. The existing acquisition never queries or samples these shadows.
